lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular lattice of high-luminance circular blobs is visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, arranged in vertical columns of approximately 4-6 nodes per column within the lateral field of view.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, acting as vertical axes for the primary spot constellations, forming a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal ridges are visible; one originating at the dorsal-most gill slit and two lower ridges running parallel along the flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition from high (superior) to low (inferior).

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, elongated biological entities (Echeneidae) exhibiting lower pixel intensity relative to the host, positioned ventrally to the pectoral fin attachment point.
